title: Multiparametric evaluation of orthopedic/radiologic measurements on radiographs and cross-sectional imaging data comparing manual and software-based automated methods-981
summary: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) on orthopedic imaging allows increasing standardization, comparability, as well as a significant increase in quality and efficiency of routine data evaluation. In terms of study technology, this benefit is planned primarily for conventional radiography (CR).
conditions: Other soft tissue disorders, not elsewhere classified

interventions.name:
retrospective analysis 
Manual and software automated acquisition of e.g.: mechanical axis deviation (MAD), anatomical axis deviation (AAD), hip-knee angle (HKA), etc.
Comparison of measured values between different modalities as well as between manual and software-based evaluation.
